name: Sher Garhi Palace
scope: Historic Sher Garhi riverfront palace architectural assembly as photographed in the1860s–1870s: northern projecting multistorey arched bay, domed timber pavilion with finial, connected long river gallery and stone revetment, southern square pavilion, raised rear hall and terminal open veranda with layered hip roofs. Original approximate rear massing closes the photographed assembly; not a measured reconstruction of the whole government compound. Later assembly/courthouse buildings, gardens and unrelated wings excluded.
era: 1860s–1870s photographed riverfront palace; nominal review date1870-01-01. No exact photographic year known.
